scripts.check:contracts: npm -w @qiming/contracts run check && npm -w @qiming/contracts run lint:openapi
scripts.check:ui: npm -w @qiming/ui run test && npm -w @qiming/ui run check
scripts.check:admin: npm -w @qiming/admin run build && npm -w @qiming/admin run test
scripts.check:teacher: npm -w @qiming/teacher run build && npm -w @qiming/teacher run test
scripts.check:student: npm -w @qiming/student run build && npm -w @qiming/student run test
scripts.check:all: npm run check:contracts && npm run check:ui && npm run check:admin && npm run check:teacher && npm run check:student && npm run check:server
scripts.check:labs: npm -w @qiming/lab run check:scripts && npm -w @qiming/lab run validate:anim && npm -w @qiming/lab run build
scripts.test:mock: npm -w @qiming/admin run test:mock && npm -w @qiming/teacher run test:mock && npm -w @qiming/student run test:mock
